During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.
Spending Rage has a 10% chance to awaken a guardian spirit for 8 sec, which attacks a nearby enemy for 106 when you cast Thrash or Mangle.
